name: Smart Search's Auto-collections tab on a desktop (1366x900). As admin: earlier runs' WC AC auto-collections and queries removed, viewer2 allowed to manage collections, a query over Movies saved. The tab third, with New, Refresh all and the All, Needs review, Errors filter; New auto-collection: Save off until a preview, the user's queries offered, locked and Keep my manual changes by default; the query chosen names it, the name is free, the preview counts and shows posters; Save makes it, up to date, with a link to its collection (a locked BoxSet of that name), its query, members and last change, and Refresh, Edit, Turn off, History, Delete. A second New with the same name: taken, with free names to pick. Edit: unlocking leaves only Release date and waits for a new preview; Save. Refresh now with its toast; History newest first; Turn off and on; the Errors filter; the Saved queries tab's Create an auto-collection opens the editor on that query. As viewer2 (a manager): admin's auto-collection without Turn off, its name and query locked in the editor. As viewer: no tab, no create button. As admin again: Refresh now ends in a '+N −M' toast without a reload; the source query edited to match nothing through the API, and the run that would empty the collection is held (shown once the window's focus reads the list again) (Needs review, its filter, Wait folds the panel and Review removals opens it, Apply asks first, Keep these items pins them and it is up to date); the query restored; the collection deleted outside the plugin shows Collection deleted without a link, and Recreate makes a new one; the source query refused to a plain delete, then removed by a forced import, shows Query missing with its last error and Choose another query. Delete keeps the collection by default; deleting it too removes the BoxSet. Screenshots smartsearch-collections-*.png. Needs a sandbox seeded by Initialize-Sandbox.ps1.

steps.name: page helpers (admin)
steps.initScript:
window.__ss = {
  root: () => [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-jfss-page="search"][data-jfss-mounted] .jfss-search')].find(x => x.getClientRects().length > 0) || null,
  q: (s) => { const r = window.__ss.root(); return r ? r.querySelector(s) : null; },
  all: (s) => { const r = window.__ss.root(); return r ? [...r.querySelectorAll(s)] : []; },
  noHScroll: () => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth && window.__ss.root().scrollWidth <= window.__ss.root().clientWidth + 1,
  box: (e) => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return [Math.round(r.width), Math.round(r.height)]; },
  api: async (method, path, body) => { const r = await fetch(ApiClient.getUrl(path), { method, headers: { 'X-Emby-Token': ApiClient.accessToken(), 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body) }); const t = await r.text(); return { status: r.status, body: t ? JSON.parse(t) : null }; },
  cleanup: async (prefix) => { let n = 0; const acs = (await window.__ss.api('GET', 'SmartSearch/AutoCollections')).body || []; for (const a of acs) { if (a.Name.indexOf(prefix) === 0) { await window.__ss.api('DELETE', 'SmartSearch/AutoCollections/' + a.Id + '?deleteCollection=true'); n++; } } const list = (await window.__ss.api('GET', 'SmartSearch/Queries?scope=Mine&limit=500')).body.Items; for (const q of list) { if (q.Name.indexOf(prefix) === 0) { await window.__ss.api('DELETE', 'SmartSearch/Queries/' + q.Id + '?detachAutoCollections=true'); n++; } } return n; },
  movies: async (name) => { const libs = (await window.__ss.api('GET', 'SmartSearch/Libraries')).body; const movies = libs.find(l => l.Name === 'Movies').Id; return (await window.__ss.api('POST', 'SmartSearch/Queries', { Name: name, Description: '', Shared: false, Query: { Version: 1, Scope: { ItemKinds: ['Movie'], LibraryIds: [movies], IncludeMissing: false }, Where: { Match: 'All', Children: [] }, Sort: [{ Key: 'SortName', Order: 'Ascending' }] } })).body; },
  dialog: () => { const d = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role="dialog"]')].filter(x => x.getClientRects().length > 0); return d[d.length - 1] || null; },
  dq: (s) => { const d = window.__ss.dialog(); return d ? d.querySelector(s) : null; },
  dset: (s, v) => { const e = window.__ss.dq(s); e.value = v; e.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; },
  dbutton: (text) => { const d = window.__ss.dialog(); return d ? [...d.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent === text) || null : null; },
  rows: () => window.__ss.all('.jfss-ac-row'),
  names: () => window.__ss.rows().map(r => r.querySelector('.jfss-ac-open').textContent),
  row: (name) => window.__ss.rows().find(r => r.querySelector('.jfss-ac-open').textContent === name) || null,
  status: (name) => { const r = window.__ss.row(name); return r ? r.querySelector('.jfss-ac-status').textContent : null; },
  action: (name, cls) => { const r = window.__ss.row(name); return r ? r.querySelector(cls) : null; },
  savedRow: (name) => window.__ss.all('.jfss-saved-row').find(r => r.querySelector('.jfss-saved-open').textContent === name) || null,
  toast: () => [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfss-toast')].map(t => t.textContent.replace(/[\u2066-\u2069]/g, '')).join(' | '),
  ready: () => !!window.__ss.q('.jfss-collections-panel') && !!window.__ss.q('.jfss-ac-count') && /auto-collection/.test(window.__ss.q('.jfss-ac-count').textContent + (window.__ss.q('.jfss-ac-notices') || {}).textContent)
};

steps.name: the source query edited to match nothing
steps.script: const q = (await __ss.api('GET', 'SmartSearch/Queries/' + __vars.setup.query)).body; const where = { Match: 'All', Children: [{ Field: 'Title', Op: 'Contains', Value: 'wc-nothing-matches-this' }] }; const r = await __ss.api('PUT', 'SmartSearch/Queries/' + q.Id, { Name: q.Name, Description: q.Description, Shared: q.Shared, Query: Object.assign({}, q.Query, { Where: where }), IfUpdatedAt: q.UpdatedUtc }); return { status: r.status, affected: ((r.body && r.body.AffectedAutoCollections) || []).map(a => a.Name), original: q.Query.Where };

the pins

steps.name: the source query refused to a plain delete (auto-collections use it), then removed by a forced import that leaves it out
steps.script: const plain = (await __ss.api('DELETE', 'SmartSearch/Queries/' + __vars.setup.query)).status; const r = await fetch(ApiClient.getUrl('SmartSearch/Admin/Export'), { headers: { 'X-Emby-Token': ApiClient.accessToken() } }); const exp = await r.json(); const norm = (x) => String(x).replace(/-/g, '').toLowerCase(); exp.Data.Queries = exp.Data.Queries.filter(q => norm(q.Id) !== norm(__vars.setup.query)); const imported = (await __ss.api('POST', 'SmartSearch/Admin/Import?mode=Replace&dryRun=false&force=true', exp)).status; return { plain, imported };
